name: fancy-rsvp-backend
description: Backend API for Fancy RSVP platform

comments.optionalDependencies: Shared rate-limit store. Without these, express-rate-limit falls back to its per-process MemoryStore — and ecosystem.config.js runs this API with instances:'max' in cluster mode, so each worker keeps its own counter and throttling becomes non-deterministic (the same client is allowed or blocked depending on which worker answered). Optional, not required: app.js degrades gracefully with a warning when they're absent or when REDIS_URL is unset, so a deploy without Redis still boots.
